# State & Coverage Checklist: AI Session Folding

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the four states a fold can be in
(running / record incomplete / not fully loaded / no prompt recorded), their
transitions, and the boundary cases around them. Constitution VI requires these
to stay distinct across every layer; this checklist asks whether the
requirements actually keep them distinct in writing.
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all four states named in the spec itself, or do three of them appear only in research §R-004? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-014, research §R-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Is a requirement defined for what a row shows when two states hold at once — a running session whose record is also incomplete? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements stated for whether folding itself can be turned off, given SC-004 measures output "with folding on and off"? No FR defines such a control. [Conflict, Spec §SC-004 vs §Functional Requirements]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for how a fold behaves while events arrive live into a running session? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the required behaviour specified when the currently selected event becomes a folded member on re-render? [Gap, Coverage]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "says so" quantified for an incomplete record — a marker, a label, a count qualifier, or unspecified? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "distinguishable from a closed one" for a running session given an observable criterion, or left to implementation? [Clarity, Spec §US3 scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "no prompt recorded" defined as an exact displayed string, or as a class of message? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the distinction between an empty `promptText` and an absent one specified? [Ambiguity, Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do the state requirements stay consistent between the event log and the track, or could a session read as running on one surface and closed on the other? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the treatment of `transcript_compacted` consistent between the edge-case list (numbering continues) and the integrity states (it is not listed as an integrity reason)? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases vs data-model §RecordIntegrity]
- [ ] CHK012 Do the requirements consistently treat `loadState` as a UI boundary rather than a data defect, everywhere both appear? [Consistency, research §R-004]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Are success criteria defined for the state model at all, or only for the folding behaviour? [Gap, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK014 Can "three different problems, three different signals" be objectively evaluated from the requirements as written? [Measurability, quickstart §Scenario 6]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements defined for the recovery path when a count query fails and is later retried? [Coverage, Recovery flow, research §R-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements stated for a session that ends while the operator has its detail open? [Coverage, Exception flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for two concurrent running sessions overlapping in time on the same lane? [Coverage, research §R-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the zero case addressed — an engagement with agent events but no complete session? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements specified for a session whose only member is a `transcript_*` advisory, with no prompt and no action? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are the edge cases listed in the spec each traceable to a stated requirement, or do some exist only as prose? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the behaviour specified when `turns_emitted` from `session_end` disagrees with the turn count derived from loaded members? [Gap, Conflict, research §R-003]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for an unknown future `agent.*` subtype, beyond the contract's compatibility note? [Coverage, contracts §3]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- CHK003 and CHK021 are contradictions between artifacts, not merely missing detail — both need a decision before tasks
